turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My daughter wants a games console for her birthday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely. Does she mostly want to play on the TV with the family, or carry it around and play on her own?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait for me, I need to talk to Lucas about something. Don't say a word until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, what's that thing you ordered last time? The cold one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Cold brew with oat milk. It's really smooth.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it strong? I don't want to be awake all night.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty strong. Maybe get a small one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I'll just have a tea and steal a sip of yours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: One sip. I know what you're like.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Have you thought about whether she'd want it for the TV or on the go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The TV. Honestly I want to play with her too.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's sweet. Pick one with good local multiplayer and grab a second controller.
